parameters.query:
WITH o AS (SELECT id, telegram_id, display_name FROM users WHERE role='owner' AND is_active=true LIMIT 1) SELECT o.telegram_id::text AS telegram_id, o.display_name, $1::text AS mode, json_build_object( 'now_cairo',to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'today_schedule',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.start_cairo),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT se.title,se.session_type,to_char(se.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS start_cairo,to_char(se.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS end_cairo,se.is_fixed,se.status FROM schedule_entries se WHERE se.user_id=o.id AND se.entry_date=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date AND se.status NOT IN ('skipped','moved')) x), 'tasks_today',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.deadline_cairo NULLS LAST),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT t.title, t.priority, t.status, t.category, t.subject, t.estimated_minutes, t.energy_required, to_char(t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deadline_cairo FROM tasks t WHERE t.user_id=o.id AND t.status IN ('pending','in_progress') AND (t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date LIMIT 25) x), 'tasks_overdue',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.deadline_cairo NULLS LAST),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT t.title, t.priority, t.status, t.category, t.subject, t.estimated_minutes, t.energy_required, to_char(t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deadline_cairo FROM tasks t WHERE t.user_id=o.id AND t.status IN ('pending','in_progress') AND t.deadline<now() AND (t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date<(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date LIMIT 25) x), 'tasks_no_deadline',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.deadline_cairo NULLS LAST),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT t.title, t.priority, t.status, t.category, t.subject, t.estimated_minutes, t.energy_required, to_char(t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deadline_cairo FROM tasks t WHERE t.user_id=o.id AND t.status IN ('pending','in_progress') AND t.deadline IS NULL LIMIT 25) x), 'upcoming_deadlines',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(d),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT title,kind,is_hard,to_char(due_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_cairo FROM deadlines WHERE user_id=o.id AND due_at>=now() AND due_at<now()+interval '7 days' ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 15) d), 'active_freelance_projects',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(f),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT title,client_name,priority,to_char(deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deadline_cairo FROM freelance_projects WHERE user_id=o.id AND status='active' ORDER BY deadline NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) f), 'tasks_tomorrow',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT t.title, t.priority, t.category, to_char(t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deadline_cairo FROM tasks t WHERE t.user_id=o.id AND t.status IN ('pending','in_progress') AND (t.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date+1 LIMIT 25) x),
 'new_opportunities',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT f.short_code AS code, f.title, m.match_score FROM opportunity_matches m JOIN freelance_opportunities f ON f.id=m.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.opportunity_id=f.id AND a.user_id=o.id WHERE m.user_id=o.id AND m.created_at>now()-interval '24 hours' AND m.match_score>=COALESCE((SELECT match_threshold FROM profiles WHERE user_id=o.id),50) AND COALESCE(a.state,'') NOT IN ('IGNORED','REJECTED','EXPIRED','PROPOSAL_SUBMITTED','ACCEPTED') ORDER BY m.match_score DESC LIMIT 5) x),
 'proposal_follow_up',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT f.short_code AS code, f.title, a.state, to_char(a.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_update FROM applications a JOIN freelance_opportunities f ON f.id=a.opportunity_id WHERE a.user_id=o.id AND a.state IN ('PROPOSAL_DRAFTED','PROPOSAL_SUBMITTED') ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 10) x)
) AS result FROM o

WITH o AS (SELECT id, telegram_id FROM users WHERE role='owner' AND is_active=true LIMIT 1),
c AS (SELECT t.id, t.title, t.deadline, o.id AS user_id, o.telegram_id FROM tasks t, o WHERE t.user_id=o.id AND t.status IN ('pending','in_progress') AND t.deadline>now() AND t.deadline<=now()+interval '24 hours'),
n AS (INSERT INTO notifications (user_id,type,importance,title,body,payload,dedupe_key,status)
  SELECT c.user_id,'deadline',CASE WHEN c.deadline<=now()+interval '6 hours' THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END,c.title,'Deadline within 24h',jsonb_build_object('task_id',c.id),'task_due24:'||c.id::text,'pending' FROM c
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id, dedupe_key)
SELECT c.telegram_id::text AS telegram_id, n.id AS notification_id, c.title, to_char(c.deadline AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_cairo FROM n JOIN c ON n.dedupe_key='task_due24:'||c.id::text
UPDATE notifications SET status='sent', sent_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.telegram_id::text AS telegram_id,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(platform, n), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT platform, count(*) AS n FROM freelance_opportunities WHERE ingestion_source='rss' GROUP BY platform) c) AS counts
FROM users u WHERE u.role='owner' AND u.is_active=true LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO notifications (user_id,type,importance,title,body,dedupe_key,status,sent_at)
SELECT NULLIF($1::text,'')::uuid,'site_down','low',$2::text,$3::text,'site_down:'||$2::text||':'||to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','YYYY-MM-DD'),'sent',now()
WHERE $1::text <> ''
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO freelance_opportunities (platform, external_id, url, title, ingestion_source, content_hash, status)
  VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $2::text, $3::text, 'rss', md5(lower($3::text)), 'DISCOVERED')
  ON CONFLICT (platform, external_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, short_code)
SELECT json_build_object('code', short_code, 'id', id, 'notify', $4::boolean) AS result FROM ins
UPDATE freelance_opportunities SET description = NULLIF($2::text,'') WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id
